cases.notes: Three heading levels with paragraphs that mix bold, italic, inline code, and an arrow token; checks hierarchy and inline formatting preservation.
Bullet list with nested bullets, a nested ordered list with a further bullet level, and task items; checks marker, indentation, and checkbox preservation.
Four-column table with left, center, and right alignment, inline code markers, and a link per row; checks row/column count and alignment parity.
TypeScript code fence, inline math, and a display equation; code and math must remain byte-identical while surrounding prose is translated.
Inline link, image with local URL, footnote reference and definition; link text and alt text are translated, URLs and footnote ids are unchanged.
GitHub Alerts NOTE and WARNING plus a plain blockquote; checks marker lines, multi-line quote structure, and quote-level translation.
Three paragraphs where it, that consistency, there, and doing so depend on earlier text; checks that Chinese references stay clear without literal pronoun copying.
Three technical paragraphs that deliberately use all glossary terms; checks exact target renderings and consistent capitalization of token.
English prose interleaved with existing Chinese sentences; the reference translates only English and keeps every Chinese sentence unchanged.
A single 120-200 word paragraph containing five numbered requirements inline; checks long-range coherence, full-width enumeration punctuation, and no accidental list creation.
YAML frontmatter with title, description, tags, and a boolean plus a short heading and paragraph; frontmatter must be preserved byte-for-byte.
Three paragraphs mixing bold commands, code spans, and links; checks natural full-width punctuation and consistent spacing between CJK and Latin/code tokens.
Inline HTML tags, escaped pipe/asterisk, double-backtick code, and a link title; checks protected-token handling while translating inline HTML text.
Negation, quantities, and a time condition; automatic structure checks cannot judge these, so human review is required.
Full-length README for a fictional CLI: status line, features, install and quick-start fences, configuration table, troubleshooting, link and footnote; checks long-form block alignment.
Production deployment runbook with a WARNING alert, prerequisites, numbered deploy and rollback steps, JSON request/response, error-code table, and a blockquote note.
